items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: He worked with my daddy. He was around my daddy when my daddy was playing drums, Joe Lindsey. I know him well.

ctx.x: He worked with my daddy. He was around my daddy when my daddy was playing drums, Joe Lindsey. I know him well. You've seen him lately.
